title: Physical AC1027 fit-only SPLINE fields compared with LibreDWG

formatAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
formatAuthority.relevantRule: R2013+ stores Spline flags 1 and Knot parameter as BL values after Scenario and before Degree. A fit-point scenario then stores fit tolerance, beginning/end tangent vectors, fit-point count as BL, and ordered fit points.

input.lineageStatement: The repository README identifies fixtures/libredwg as samples from LibreDWG test/test-data; this receipt does not infer original authoring application.
input.fixtureDisposition: Downloaded to /private/tmp for read-only research; no DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.

libdxfrw.implementation: src/drw_entities.cpp reads both R2013+ fields using readBoundedBitLong when version > AC1024.

captureHarness.readObservation: readSucceeded=true, sourceVersion=AC1027, legacyError=0; two SPLINE callbacks captured. The complete read also reports three unrelated object parse failures and one orphaned DataStorage record.

existingGeneratedControls: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp::runR2013SplineBitLongBoundaryTest directly writes nontrivial BL values for both fields, checks decoded fields and verifies following-body sentinel alignment.

The --spline-fit-only-dxf selector creates literal ASCII/Binary DXF input, checks parsed fit-only data, audits emitted group codes, and reads back the output while checking the following LINE. It passed directly and is now registered as CTest libdxfrw_spline_fit_only_dxf.

comparison.method: Match physical SPLINE records by decoded DWG handle, compare typed read fields against LibreDWG's direct DWG JSON, and recursively compare all numeric values with absolute tolerance 1e-12 plus relative tolerance 1e-12.

decision: The existing AC1027 parser field widths and typed values agree with ODA v5.4.1 and an independent DWG reader for these two fit-only records. This witness gives no basis for a parser change; retain the current BL decoding path.

isolatedDxfOutputReadback.result: PASS; both captured typed SPLINE records exported to AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXF, were imported again, and matched flags, degree, fit count, fit tolerance, tangents and ordered fit points.
isolatedDxfOutputReadback.scope: This isolated typed-entity projection bypasses whole-document conversion. It does not compare or preserve splFlag1/knotParam as independent DXF fields and does not qualify curve equivalence or native behavior.

fastSelector.result: PASS; CTest 1/1, 0.07 seconds, covering generated ASCII/Binary input, raw output audit and readback.

limits: This is a two-record read-field differential plus isolated DXF field transport/readback, not SPLINE curve evaluation or native CAD acceptance.
The drawing read has unrelated parse failures and orphaned DataStorage; it is not a complete-conversion witness.
Strict whole-file output remains refused at the standalone TABLEGEOMETRY dependency, as recorded in p6-ac1027-exact-header-size-exclusion-2026-11-01.json.
One public AC1027 sample does not qualify every R2013+ producer, spline scenario, edit path, or support claim.
